_comment: Original one-line synopsis DRAFTS for scripts/build-catalog-cleanup.ts. Written from facts only; never wiki (CC BY-SA) or publisher prose. Every fill is marked drafted for operator review.

a-new-hope-the-princess-the-scoundrel-an.synopsis: A middle-grade retelling of A New Hope told in three parts, one each from Leia, Han, and Luke.

ahsoka-a-novelization-of-season-one.synopsis: A junior novelization of Ahsoka's first season, as Ahsoka and Sabine Wren race to find Thrawn and Ezra Bridger.

before-the-awakening.synopsis: Three stories follow Finn, Rey, and Poe Dameron in the days before The Force Awakens.

before-the-storm.synopsis: Leia faces the Yevetha's warlike Nil Spaar while Luke searches for clues about his mother and Lando chases a derelict alien ship.

children-of-the-jedi.synopsis: Luke meets the spirit of Jedi Callista aboard the reawakened dreadnaught Eye of Palpatine as Leia searches Belsavis for lost Jedi children.

dark-nest-i-the-joiner-king.synopsis: Young Jedi answer a mysterious summons to the Unknown Regions and are drawn into the Killik hive's border war with the Chiss.

dark-nest-ii-the-unseen-queen.synopsis: The Skywalkers and Solos discover the Dark Nest still lives as Killik-fueled piracy pushes the Colony toward war.

dark-nest-iii-the-swarm-war.synopsis: Luke reshapes the Jedi Order as the Chiss-Killik conflict explodes into open war and the Dark Nest makes its final move.

darksaber.synopsis: Durga the Hutt builds a Death Star-based superweapon as Admiral Daala rallies the Empire and Luke seeks to restore Callista's Force powers.

eyes-like-stars.synopsis: Teen Ardent Quay falls for a mysterious stowaway on her family's tour ship as they try to return an artifact home ahead of the First Order.

galaxys-edge-a-crash-of-fate.synopsis: A smuggler returns to Batuu after thirteen years and reconnects with her childhood friend Jules just as a delivery job turns dangerous.

galaxys-edge-black-spire.synopsis: Resistance spy Vi Moradi and ex-stormtrooper Archex try to build a rebel cell at Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

hard-merchandise.synopsis: Boba Fett and the amnesiac Neelah follow evidence tying Prince Xizor to a galaxy-shaking conspiracy as the Bounty Hunter Wars conclude.

heir-to-the-empire-the-20th-anniversary-.synopsis: An annotated anniversary reissue of Heir to the Empire, with commentary by Zahn and a new Thrawn novella, Crisis of Faith.

hiding-from-the-dark.synopsis: In a middle-grade horror tale, a girl named Bia escapes Coruscant to find her mother while a shadowy hunter closes in.

hunters-battle-for-the-arena.synopsis: A Force-sensitive orphan joins the combat teams of Vespaara's Grand Arena and must learn to trust her teammates as a stranger shadows the competition.

join-the-resistance.synopsis: Would-be hero Mattis Banz joins a squad of misfit Resistance recruits who must learn to work together.

join-the-resistance-attack-on-starkiller.synopsis: J-Squadron's young recruits race to rejoin the Resistance in time for the attack on Starkiller Base.

join-the-resistance-escape-from-vodran.synopsis: Captured by the First Order on Vodran, J-Squadron splits up as some recruits plot an escape and others bargain with a Hutt.

landos-luck.synopsis: After a smuggling job goes wrong, Lando and L3-37 must choose between profit and helping a planet that needs a stolen artifact returned.

last-shot.synopsis: Han and Lando team up years after Endor to stop a vengeful inventor's device, in a story that jumps between three eras.

legacy.synopsis: Between The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker, Leia and Rey travel to a Jedi temple on Tython to repair Rey's broken lightsaber.

master-of-evil.synopsis: Newly armored Darth Vader obsessively hunts for a way to cheat death, chasing rumors of a shaman who can raise the dead.

moving-target-a-princess-leia-adventure.synopsis: Between Empire and Jedi, Leia leads a small team on a decoy mission to draw Imperial attention away from the rebel fleet.

pirates-price.synopsis: Pirate Hondo Ohnaka recounts his colorful encounters with Han, Chewie, and the Millennium Falcon.

planet-of-twilight.synopsis: Leia is taken captive on the former prison world Nam Chorios while Luke searches for Callista and an ancient parasite awakens.

poe-dameron-free-fall.synopsis: Sixteen-year-old Poe Dameron leaves Yavin 4 for a piloting job and ends up flying for the Kijimi spice runners.

princess-of-the-rebellion.synopsis: After Yavin, Leia, Luke, and Han search for a hidden weapons cache left by Bail Organa to secure a new rebel base.

reign-of-the-empire-edge-of-the-abyss.synopsis: A year before Andor, Mon Mothma and Bail Organa confront the Empire's grip on truth while fractured rebel cells fight to survive.

reign-of-the-empire-from-the-ashes.synopsis: The newly united Rebel Alliance struggles to hold together as Mon Mothma and Bail Organa build its base on Yavin 4.

republic-commando-hard-contact.synopsis: Clone commando squad Omega is dropped behind Separatist lines on Qiilura to wipe out a nanovirus designed to kill clones.

republic-commando-triple-zero.synopsis: Omega Squad hunts a Separatist terror network and a mole inside Republic command on Coruscant.

return-of-the-jedi-beware-the-power-of-t.synopsis: A playful middle-grade retelling of Return of the Jedi by Origami Yoda author Tom Angleberger.

sanctuary-a-bad-batch-novel.synopsis: Hunter, Tech, Wrecker, and Omega take risky jobs to fund Pabu's recovery, then find themselves shielding two fugitives hunted by the ISB.

servants-of-the-empire-edge-of-the-galax.synopsis: Lothal teen Zare Leonis begins to doubt the Empire when his sister vanishes from the Imperial Academy.

servants-of-the-empire-imperial-justice.synopsis: Undercover cadet Zare Leonis falls under suspicion at Lothal's academy while Merei digs deeper into Imperial secrets.

servants-of-the-empire-rebel-in-the-rank.synopsis: Zare Leonis enrolls at Lothal's Imperial Academy to secretly investigate his sister's disappearance.

servants-of-the-empire-the-secret-academ.synopsis: Zare Leonis's search for his missing sister leads him to Commandant Hux's academy on Arkanis, where exposure could mean death.

shadow-games.synopsis: Dash Rendar signs on as bodyguard to a galactic pop star whose tour is plagued by murders and ties to Black Sun.

shield-of-lies.synopsis: Han spies on the Yevethan fleet, Lando is trapped aboard a runaway alien ship, and Luke studies with the Fallanassi.

slave-ship.synopsis: Boba Fett fakes his death and chases a huge bounty that pulls him into Prince Xizor's plot to break the Bounty Hunters Guild.

smugglers-run-a-han-solo-and-chewbacca-a.synopsis: After Yavin, Han and Chewbacca reluctantly extract a rebel officer from Cyrkon with an ISB agent on their tail.

solo-a-star-wars-story-a-junior-novel.synopsis: A junior novelization of Solo: A Star Wars Story, with extra and deleted scenes.

solo-a-star-wars-story-expanded-edition.synopsis: The film novelization of Solo, with added scenes including Han's Imperial Navy service and Qi'ra's past.

spark-of-the-resistance.synopsis: Rey, Rose, Poe, and BB-8 answer a distress call and defend Minfar's Zixon people from the First Order.

star-wars-a-new-hope-paperback-novel.synopsis: A junior novel adaptation of A New Hope, revised for current canon for Star Wars' 40th anniversary in 2017.

star-wars-episode-i-the-phantom-menace.synopsis: The novelization of The Phantom Menace, opening with young Anakin's life on Tatooine before the Jedi arrive.

star-wars-episode-ii-attack-of-the-clone.synopsis: The novelization of Attack of the Clones, expanding on Anakin and Padmé and adding scenes that never made the final film.

star-wars-galaxies-the-ruins-of-dantooin.synopsis: An Imperial bioengineer secretly aiding the Rebellion helps a rebel spy recover a holocron listing rebel sympathizers.

star-wars-outlaws-low-red-moon.synopsis: Disinherited heir Jaylen Vrax and reprogrammed battle droid ND-5 build an underworld partnership in this Outlaws prequel.

star-wars-return-of-the-jedi-paperback-n.synopsis: A junior novel adaptation of Return of the Jedi, revised for current canon for Star Wars' 40th anniversary in 2017.

star-wars-rogue-one-a-junior-novel.synopsis: A junior novelization of Rogue One, following Jyn Erso's mission to steal the Death Star plans.

star-wars-the-clone-wars.synopsis: The novelization of the 2008 Clone Wars film, in which Anakin and new Padawan Ahsoka rescue Jabba's kidnapped son.

star-wars-the-empire-strikes-back-paperb.synopsis: A junior novel adaptation of The Empire Strikes Back, revised for current canon for Star Wars' 40th anniversary in 2017.

star-wars-the-force-awakens.synopsis: The novelization of The Force Awakens, as Rey, Finn, and Poe are drawn into the fight against the First Order.

star-wars-the-force-awakens-a-junior-nov.synopsis: A junior novelization of The Force Awakens, following Rey and Finn from Jakku to Starkiller Base.

star-wars-the-force-unleashed.synopsis: Darth Vader's secret apprentice hunts the last Jedi while being groomed to help overthrow the Emperor.

star-wars-the-force-unleashed-ii.synopsis: A clone of Vader's former apprentice escapes Kamino and searches for Juno Eclipse and the truth of his identity.

star-wars-the-last-jedi-a-junior-novel.synopsis: A junior novelization of The Last Jedi with extended and exclusive scenes.

star-wars-the-last-jedi-expanded-edition.synopsis: The novelization of The Last Jedi, developed with Rian Johnson's input and including scenes from alternate drafts.

star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-a-junior.synopsis: A junior novelization of The Rise of Skywalker with deleted and extended scenes.

star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-expanded.synopsis: The novelization of The Rise of Skywalker with expanded scenes and material not seen in the film.

stories-of-jedi-and-sith.synopsis: Ten short stories by different authors pit iconic Jedi against Sith, from Obi-Wan and Luke to Vader and Maul.

survivors-quest.synopsis: Luke and Mara Jade travel to the Unknown Regions to recover the wreck of the Outbound Flight Jedi expedition.

tatooine-ghost.synopsis: Han and Leia go to Tatooine to recover a lost Alderaanian painting hiding a vital code, and Leia learns about her father's past.

the-book-of-boba-fett-junior-novel.synopsis: A junior novelization of The Book of Boba Fett, as Boba and Fennec Shand take over Jabba's former territory on Tatooine.

the-clone-wars-no-prisoners.synopsis: Ahsoka and Captain Rex join Gilad Pellaeon's rescue of a Republic spy, and Ahsoka meets a Jedi who rejects Order tradition.

the-clone-wars-wild-space.synopsis: Obi-Wan and Bail Organa chase intelligence to a remote world that proves far more dangerous than they expect.

the-crystal-star.synopsis: Leia searches for her kidnapped children while Luke and Han investigate a strange cult near a crystallizing star.

the-empire-strikes-back-so-you-want-to-b.synopsis: A middle-grade retelling of The Empire Strikes Back that puts the reader in Luke's place as he trains to be a Jedi.

the-high-republic-a-valiant-vow.synopsis: Padawans and younglings join forces against the spreading blight and swarms of destructive scav droids.

the-high-republic-beware-the-nameless.synopsis: Ram Jomaram and a group of stowaway younglings answer a distress call in the Occlusion Zone and face the Nameless.

the-high-republic-escape-from-valo.synopsis: Trapped on Nihil-occupied Valo, Padawan Ram Jomaram leads three young Jedi in protecting his home.

the-high-republic-quest-for-planet-x.synopsis: Prospectors Dass and Sky enlist Padawan Rooper Nitani in a hunt for the legendary Planet X.

the-high-republic-quest-for-the-hidden-c.synopsis: Jedi Silandra Sho and Padawan Rooper Nitani search the monster-haunted planet Gloam for a missing Pathfinder team.

the-last-jedi-cobalt-squadron.synopsis: Bomber crew sisters Rose and Paige Tico risk a covert mission to deliver aid to a system the First Order is starving.

the-last-order.synopsis: After The Rise of Skywalker, Finn and Jannah track the First Order officer behind the kidnapping of a shipful of children.

the-legends-of-luke-skywalker.synopsis: Deckhands on a ship to Canto Bight swap tall tales about Luke Skywalker, unsure which are true.

the-mandalorian-armor.synopsis: Boba Fett escapes the Sarlacc as flashbacks reveal Prince Xizor's scheme to turn the Bounty Hunters Guild against itself.

the-mandalorian-junior-novel.synopsis: A junior novelization of The Mandalorian's first season, as Din Djarin chooses to protect the Child.

the-mandalorian-season-2-junior-novel.synopsis: A junior novelization of The Mandalorian's second season, as Din Djarin seeks a Jedi to take in Grogu.

the-mighty-chewbacca-in-the-forest-of-fe.synopsis: Chewbacca takes a job in a fear-inducing forest to recover a dark artifact and save Han Solo.

the-new-rebellion.synopsis: A Dark Jedi named Kueller threatens the New Republic with mass murder while Han is framed for a Senate bombing.

the-princess-and-the-scoundrel.synopsis: Han and Leia marry on Endor and honeymoon aboard the luxury starliner Halcyon as Imperial remnants threaten the peace.

the-weapon-of-a-jedi-a-luke-skywalker-ad.synopsis: Luke is drawn to a Jedi temple on Devaron, where he must protect a local girl and duel the scavenger Sarco Plank.

twin-crossroads.synopsis: Training together after Endor, Luke and Leia go undercover on Coruscant and confront their parents' legacy.

tyrants-test.synopsis: Chewbacca leads a rescue for the captured Han as Leia commits the New Republic to war with the Yevetha.

x-wing-isards-revenge.synopsis: Rogue Squadron reluctantly allies with Ysanne Isard to free prisoners held by Warlord Krennel.

x-wing-mercy-kill.synopsis: Decades later, Wraith Squadron reunites to expose a Galactic Alliance general tied to the Lecersen Conspiracy.

x-wing-starfighters-of-adumar.synopsis: Wedge and three veteran pilots lead a diplomatic mission to Adumar, a world that prizes fighter pilots above all.

skipped.star-wars-starfighter: unreleased film novelization (2027-06-22); only a one-line announcement exists — the plot is not public, so no accurate synopsis can be written yet
